Moves objects to deferred, roadmap, or archived when a lifecycle edge exists
(including '*' → archived). Archive is the antithesis of the draft plane: the
CRIT↔BLI↔REQ cluster (and PRI children when parking a plan) shockwaves together.
If any hop is blocked, the whole tree stays on the prior membrane.
Use this instead of promote/demote/--override for acknowledged-but-not-now or
permanent history exits. Parents (goal/milestone/mission/vision) stay as lineage.

IDs may be positional args, comma-separated (ID1,ID2), and/or --ids.

  Defer an exploring idea
  zqk.test object park BLI-… --to deferred
  Horizon-park validated work
  zqk.test object park BLI-… --to roadmap
  Archive cluster (history) from any status
  zqk.test object park CRIT-… --to archived
  Park many (comma-separated seeds; one unioned tree)
  zqk.test object park BLI-001,BLI-002 --to deferred

Usage:
  zqk.test object park <id>[,id...] [id...] [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ids string              Comma-separated list of object IDs (same as positional multi-ID / comma lists)
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
      --to string               Park target: deferred | roadmap | archived (required)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
